manifest.purpose: The golden answer file for the analysis_report submission. Contains exactly three fields: recombination_net set to 'recombine_xor', recombination_register set to 'recombined_sbox_q', and leakage_type set to 'first-order switching leakage'. This file is placed at golden/vulnerability_report.json and will be overlaid onto submission/vulnerability_report.json during grading. The evaluator checks field presence/format (FR1-FR3) and exact string matches against the hidden ground truth (SR1-SR3).
